**PotentialPatina 1.3.0**

- **ERA**: one tap sets all six sections for a sound of its time: Patina, '50s 78, '60s 45, '70s Tape, '80s Sampler, '90s Cassette, AM Radio and VHS. They're in the MPC's PRESET menu too.
- **AGE**: clean to fully worn in one move. As it rises, the sections come in one after another (tone first, then drive, noise, wobble, and digital and space last). 50 % is the sound exactly as set, so projects from before sound the same; above that everything keeps going, well past it.
- **DUCK** (NOISE): turns the noise down while the music plays (up to about 26 dB), so the crackle sits under the beat and comes up in the gaps.
- The six sections are a little shorter to make room for the ERA strip along the bottom. Three parameters were added at the end of the list (Era, Age, Noise Duck); saved projects open as before.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialPatina-1.3.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpatina/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialPatina-1.3.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialPatina-1.3.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialPatina-1.3.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpatina/issues/new/choose).
